categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Has the P2P label and modifies outbound message validation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents potential memory corruption and aborts by validating message types and payload size bounds in CConnman::PushMessage(). As noted in the description, 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 can overwrite the first payload byte or write past its encoding buffer', eliminating a dangerous transport-layer hazard.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Lacks the RPC label and the 4-line adjustment in src/rpc/net.cpp merely applies P2P bounds to sendmsgtopeer.
categories.rationale: The change in src/rpc/net.cpp is a direct consequence of the P2P protocol boundary enforcement rather than a substantive change to the RPC subsystem.
